title: Clone mean long code table
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let $M$ be a positive natural number, and let $A:(V(G)\times\{-1,1\}^q)\times\{0,\ldots,M-1\}\to\{\pm1\}$ be an assignment. The clone mean long code table assigns to each vertex the function on the sign cube whose value at a query is the mean of the assignment over the $M$ clones at that vertex and query; each such function takes values in $[-1,1]$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$
